data.action: 双手持细剑，标准刺击预备姿势
data.description: 【陈 · 军校剑术课】维多利亚皇家近卫学院的旧击剑馆，晨光斜照木地板。学员时代的陈身着藏青礼服制服，手持细剑摆出标准刺击姿势，动作干净利落——「剑术的第一课不是出剑，是收剑。风笛，再来一次。」
data.lighting: cool morning light through tall hall windows
data.location: 维多利亚皇家近卫学院击剑馆
data.promptProse: Cadet Chen holds a slender rapier in both gloved hands in a precise thrust-ready stance inside the Victoria Royal Guard Academy fencing hall. Her navy double-breasted uniform and gold trim remain clear in an eye-level medium view. Tall windows rise along the hall's side and wooden boards lead behind her. Cool morning light catches the blade and epaulettes, casting long window divisions across the floor.
